decision_record.calculation: Fixture: one qualifier (count 5) delivered twice -> control 2 entry intents for CONF in one pass (2x 3000 notional); treatment 1.
decision_record.comparison: Pre-change rule: each duplicate row ranks and enters; the sleeve's own book test reads the pre-pass book, never its own staged intents, so both rows emit in one pass.
decision_record.experiment: Adapters3 A/B: ON drops the repeat; OFF reproduces both entries exactly. Falsifier: two DIFFERENT symbols — both pass.
decision_record.mechanism: Execution integrity: duplicate-intent suppression at the adapter layer (first entry per symbol kept, repeats dropped), paired record per drop.
decision_record.transfer: One qualifier row = one 3%-of-equity slot. A duplicated row in the weekly qualifier product is a data-pipeline hiccup, not two signals; honoring it doubles one name's risk past its slot.

switch: extra.confluence_enh2.dedupe_entries default ON; OFF restores the duplicate-row rule exactly
